import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int y;
        int capacity;
        int flow;
        int cost;

        Edge() {}

        Edge(int _y, int _capacity, int _flow, int _cost) {
            y = _y;
            capacity = _capacity;
            flow = _flow;
            cost = _cost;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first;
        int second;

        Pair(int _first, int _second) {
            first = _first;
            second = _second;
        }
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        FastScanner() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    static FastScanner sc = new FastScanner();

    static int norm(int a) {
        return ((a % 1000000007) + 1000000007) % 1000000007;
    }

    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int) (a * 1L * b % 1000000007);
    }

    static int binPow(int a, int k) {
        int ans = 1;
        for (; k > 0; k >>= 1) {
            if (k % 2 == 1) {
                ans = mul(ans, a);
            }
            a = mul(a, a);
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int inv(int a) {
        int b = binPow(a, 1000000007 - 2);
        assert(mul(a, b) == 1);
        return b;
    }

    static void addEdge(int x, int y, int capacity, int cost, List<Edge>[] g, List<Edge> e) {
        g[x].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(y, capacity, 0, cost));
        g[y].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(x, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void pushFlow(List<Edge>[] g, List<Edge> e, int[] dist, int[] pred, int[] pe, int[] inq, int source, int target) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pe, -1);
        Arrays.fill(inq, 0);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(source);
        inq[source] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int k = q.poll();
            inq[k] = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < g[k].size(); i++) {
                int x = g[k].get(i);
                if (e.get(x).capacity - e.get(x).flow == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                int cost = e.get(x).cost;
                int y = e.get(x).y;
                if (dist[y] > dist[k] + cost) {
                    dist[y] = dist[k] + cost;
                    pred[y] = k;
                    pe[y] = x;
                    if (inq[y] == 0) {
                        inq[y] = 1;
                        q.add(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int cur = target;
        while (cur != source) {
            e.get(pe[cur]).flow++;
            e.get(pe[cur] ^ 1).flow--;
            cur = pred[cur];
        }
        int ans = dist[target];
        for (int i = 0; i < e.size(); i++) {
            ans += e.get(i).cost * e.get(i).flow;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void input() {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        List<Edge>[] g = new List[n + m + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n + m + 2; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
        int source = n + m;
        int target = n + m + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            addEdge(source, i, 1, 0, g, e);
        }
        int timeLayers = 101;
        for (int i = 0; i < timeLayers; i++) {
            addEdge(i * n, target, k, i * c, g, e);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            --x;
            --y;
            for (int j = 0; j < timeLayers - 1; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < k; l++) {
                    addEdge(x + i * n, y + i * n + n, 1, d * (l * 2 + 1), g, e);
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < timeLayers - 1; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < k; l++) {
                    addEdge(y + i * n, x + i * n + n, 1, d * (l * 2 + 1), g, e);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < timeLayers - 1; j++) {
                addEdge(i + j * n, i + j * n + n, k, 0, g, e);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            pushFlow(g, e, new int[n + m + 2], new int[n + m + 2], new int[n + m + 2], new int[n + m + 2], source, target);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        input();
    }
}
